title: The map everyone shared
label: Original fictional case material · Educational simulation

answer.reflection: The circle identifies a nearby site. The controlled drain comparison demonstrates a mechanism within this model; another measurement could help distinguish competing explanations.

conclusionText: The model shows a possible mechanism, but this selection of evidence does not establish one unique cause.
uncertaintyTexts: This simplified synthetic world omits real ground, drainage and measurement uncertainties.

conditionResults.detail: A relevant one-factor numerical experiment is required.
A bounded conclusion must distinguish model sensitivity from unique identification.

assessment.note: Fixed educational rubric for a saved game briefing. Local results are not verified public rankings or real-world operational conclusions.

provenance.note: Generated by the same educational model; not an independent validation or real measurement.

assumptions: Local fictional planar metre coordinates; no geographic degree calculation.
Proximity, network connectivity and physical arrival time are different measures.

properties.meaning: Straight-line proximity only; not a flood boundary or travel-time zone.

assumptions: Only identical saved sample times are compared; no interpolated evidence is invented.
Fits use the supplied observation snapshot and stated tolerance.
A one-factor response establishes model sensitivity, not independent real-world validation.
